title: 2025 budget and operations centre grant application
subtitle: Fleet policy, 2025 fees and charges, business plan amendment, staffing strategy and delegations from both business improvement areas.
overview: The Committee of the Whole spent the day on the 2025 budget. The committee recommended that Council approve the 2025 Budget {{vote:m6}}. The CAO's summary put the overall Township property tax impact at 3.49%. The budget maintains existing service levels, invests in asset management, adds staff positions, funds a termite management program and includes a $200,000 TIEG payment. Provincial grant funding is reduced.

On the new Township Operations Centre, the committee recommended that staff apply to the FCM Municipal Fleet Electrification Fund, and it received an updated Class C construction cost estimate for information {{vote:m1}}. Staff said the project would not qualify for a second FCM fund, the Sustainable Municipal and Community Buildings Fund.

The committee also recommended a new Fleet Policy effective December 31, 2024 {{vote:m2}}, the 2025 fees and charges by-law {{vote:m3}}, and the 2025 Business Plan as amended {{vote:m4}}. The amendment adds affordable housing to an action item on helping people who work in the community afford to live there. Both business improvement areas presented their budgets. The Fergus BIA noted a 7.68% levy increase. Council will consider these recommendations at a later meeting.

decisions.detail: The committee recommended that Council approve the 2025 Budget {{vote:m6}}.
The committee recommended applying to the FCM Municipal Fleet Electrification Fund and received the updated Class C construction cost estimate for information.
The committee recommended approving the 2025 Business Plan as amended, with affordable housing added to an action item on workers being able to afford to live locally.
The committee recommended a by-law setting 2025 fees and charges, repealing by-laws 2023-95, 2024-29 and 2024-45.
The committee recommended a by-law endorsing a new Fleet Policy, with staff to follow it from December 31, 2024.
The committee recommended adopting Report COR2024-71 on additional financial disclosure for the 2025 budget, a routine annual requirement.
